label: Ensemble
description: Streetscapes and urban fabric — many buildings speaking as one subject.

items.name: canal-house-row
items.text: a row of canal houses shoulder to shoulder, stepped and bell gables in oxblood and ochre brick, hoisting beams jutting from the attics, facades leaning a degree or two out over the water

items.name: cycladic-village
items.text: a cliff village of whitewashed cubes stacked down the caldera rim, blue domes and doors, lanes narrowing into stairways between the houses

items.name: machiya-lane
items.text: a lane of timber machiya townhouses, fine wooden lattices over the ground floors, noren curtains breathing in the doorways, tiled eaves stepping down the street in overlapping waves

items.name: street-canyon
items.text: a deep midtown street canyon, granite and glass cliffs squeezing the sky to one bright slot, fire escapes zigzagging down the older walls

items.name: hillside-patchwork
items.text: a hillside neighborhood of hand-built houses stacked to the ridge, raw brick and painted plaster patched in teal, coral and yellow, staircase alleys threading the slope

items.name: italian-hilltown
items.text: an Italian hill town wound around its crag, stone houses sharing walls all the way up to the campanile, terracotta roofs interlocking like scales

items.name: shophouse-row
items.text: a row of Peranakan shophouses, pastel facades dressed with pilasters and glazed majolica tiles, shuttered windows above the shaded five-foot-way arcade

items.name: timber-wharf-row
items.text: a row of tarred and ochre timber wharf houses leaning into each other along the quay, gable hoists hanging over the water, plank alleys running back between them
